_about: H2/H8 Wash, stitch, plaster (docs/archive/clinic/clinic-design-v1.md, quality pass Q4 and Q5). The reference healing game for docs/architecture/clinic-heal-api.md (js/clinic/heal/games/cut.js). Real Kutchi only where it exists: pela, ne poi, paani, the numbers hakro/ba/trae/char/panj, wadho/nindho. Everything in [brackets] is an English placeholder (grey italic on screen). Level 1 is taught (the first-ever healing game: three one-word steps, said one at a time, the tray in that order); from level 2 the counts, the plaster's colour and (level 3) the order by size are the ear rows.

cut-why.e: I fell over and scraped my arm.
cut-why._src: moved out of the game's code into its data so the engine holds it (step 4e, G26); English placeholder, to record

cut-goal.e: Let's clean it and put plasters on.
cut-goal._src: moved out of the game's code into its data so the engine holds it (step 4e, G26); English placeholder, to record

camera._about: D2 (1 Oct): the wide shot the zoom starts from, chosen by the angle the close-up needs (front-on or side-on). No side-on sitting pose exists yet: 'side' uses the front pose until the art batch (art list A1).
camera._target: A1 (5 Oct): the match cut. target = where the close-up draws the sore part and size = its radius, in the close-up's 800 x 500 units: the push-in ends with the patient's part (from the art's anchor) at that place and size.

art._about: heal-A, 2 Oct: the close-up art swaps in by file name (docs/design-language/art-plans/clinic-heal-art-plan.md § 8). The code draws the stand-in until `on` is true; the cut session sets `on` once the file exists. box = where the picture sits, in the close-up's svg units (800 x 500).

cloth-dab.why: S1, CLN-99: the cloth in the hand while dabbing (art run s02)

forearm-graze._a1: A1 (5 Oct; the picture is F2 since CLN-121, registered to F1, so the box holds): its wrist (950, 460 in the source) at (510, 350), so the fingers end before the tool column (CLN-74), the sleeve off the left edge. kinds: as the knee. size, tip and wrist (source px) let the game slide it so the fingertips end before the tool column on every screen.
forearm-graze._cln121: CLN-121 (9 Oct): the landed F2 (forearm, grazed) is the close-up, so the wound is the art's own; the game no longer draws its graze over it, only the dirt, the wet and the plasters. wound: the art's graze centre in source px (measured by its pinkness over F1, build/cut_graze_stain.py). wounds: where each plaster's patch sits, by plaster count, in source px (the patches move with the picture when it slides, CLN-74); a point equal to wound is the art's own graze, any other gets the stain. The second sits nearer the wrist, about 140 svg units from the first (the old patches were 150 apart), as far below the arm's top edge as the first
forearm-graze._patchDy: the graze is 51 px below the arm's top edge (354 at x 618, 377 at x 850) and a plaster is 65 px half-height (78 svg units x 1/0.6), so centred on the graze it stood above the arm (s04-f3 shots); 17 px lower its top meets the edge and it still covers the graze (core y 375-448)

stain._about: CLN-121 (9 Oct): build/cut_graze_stain.py cuts the art's own graze out as a multiply stain (graze over plain, feathered); the game lays it on bare skin for the second plaster at L2 and L3 (the art has one graze). size: in source px; at: the graze centre it was cut round

knee-graze._a1: A1 (5 Oct; the picture is K3 since CLN-121, registered to K1, so the box holds; the game no longer draws a graze): its knee's front (950, 390 in the source) at (440, 350), so both plaster patches (x 235 and 385) sit on bare skin. kinds: the child limbs' cloth is white (the girl's leggings) until the fabric tint is built.
knee-graze._cln121: CLN-121 (9 Oct): the landed K3 (knee, grazed) is the close-up, so the wound is the art's own (on the front of the kneecap); the game draws only the dirt, the wet and the plasters. wound, wounds, stain: as forearm-graze; at L2 and L3 the second graze is the stain on the thigh above the knee, about 150 svg units left of the first

stain._about: CLN-121 (9 Oct): build/cut_graze_stain.py cuts the art's own graze out as a multiply stain (graze over plain, feathered); the game lays it on bare skin for the second plaster at L2 and L3 (the art has one graze). size: in source px; at: the graze centre it was cut round
